translation.uk: зефір, лагідний (західний) вітер; основа назви Зефрас

notes: Darnassian (Skyborne dialect). Stem of the island name and its derivatives: Zephr-as (island), Zephr-ali (demonym on 32 items), Zephr-aalis (surname), zephar-aalis (letter, with an extra a). The other Skyborne islands are also weather words + -as: Sirocc-as (sirocco), Anvil-as (anvil cloud). The 'wind' sense is the designers' etymology (Greek Zephyros); no Skyborne text uses zephr- as a free noun for 'wind'. Overlaps generated othina 'wind' (canon:false).
